content.stem: 与使用“哈瓦拉”相关的金融犯罪风险可能源于：（选择两项。）

options.A: 难以追踪交易的发起方、接收方和资金来源
options.B: 由第三方程序管理员进行远程身份验证
options.C: 高级政治人物的频繁使用
options.D: 用于跨境交易的非正式网络，这些交易游离于正规银行体系之外
options.E: 交易被退回的风险增加

content.stem_en: Financial crime risk related to the use of "hawalas" can stem from: (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Difficulty in tracking the originator, recipient, and source of transactions
options_en.B: Remote verification of identity by third-party program managers
options_en.C: Heavy usage by senior political figures
options_en.D: Informal networks used for cross-border transactions outside of the formal banking system
